verified.review_note: The official Premier League API record identifies Wesley Moraes Ferreira da Silva, gives the exact DOB 24 November 1996, and records Aston Villa as his previous team (he is now at Stoke City). This full-name and club history match the 2023-24 FPL row, code 213345, at Aston Villa. 11v11 gives the conflicting date 26 November; Transfermarkt agrees with the official API on 24 November. Confidence: high, based on the first-party exact-date record plus matching full name and club history.
